parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the details of the clusters that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account, such as cluster IDs.

parameters.name: InterfaceVersion
parameters.description:
Queries data masking rules or encryption rules. Valid values:

v1: queries data masking rules. v2: queries data encryption rules.

parameters.name: RuleNameList
parameters.description: The name of the masking rule.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-masking-rules --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000000 --rule-name-list testrule --interface-version v1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb DescribeMaskingRules --region cn-hangzhou --InterfaceVersion v1 --RuleNameList testrule --DBClusterId 'pc-00000000000000000'
